title: Investigation of the effects of albumin-gluteraldehyde tissue adhesive on human gingival fibroblast cells Doğanay Ö
authors: Atasoy S, Diker N, Alkan A. Yeditepe Dent J. 2020 Jan;16:213 -219.. doi: 10.5505/yeditepe.2020.71501.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “It was obviously seen that human gingival fibroblast cells showed cytotoxic behavior against supernatants gathered from the group of albumin-gluteraldehyde tissue adhesive” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
